about.title: The band
paragraphs: Born from the meeting of Betty, Jenni and Lauris, Flow Therapy is a trio from Martigues united by a shared desire: to create music that takes you on a journey, brings people together and moves them.
After giving timeless classics an original new spin, the trio naturally turned to songwriting to explore a universal theme: life, with all its beauty, trials, fragility and joys.
Through songs filled with empathy and sensitivity, the three artists share their perspective on a world that is at once intense, wonderful and sometimes unsettling — with strength and energy.

In 2026, their original song “Toi mon frère” received the award for Best Intergenerational Song at the national Music’al competition, sponsored by Bruno Bénabar and chaired by Gérard Pont, president of Les Francofolies. This recognition gives wings to the trio as they prepare their first EP.
